rules: Every existing event has an explicit entrance; no additional enemies or density increase.
Normal retains two shooters, two flyers and 2.2-second shooter recovery.
Stationary shooters never use foreground positive-Z. Floor entries rise through a registered hatch at their supported feet.

Side runners require supported ingress from outside the current viewport to the first fully visible position, then use ordinary movement/contact. Reject unsafe paths; never interpolate through pits or machinery.
Top and bottom flying entries require a clear authored approach. Bottom entries must use a credible opening or safe staging path, never visibly cross solid floor.
Keep the existing single foreground runner and single background pipe runner; neither entry becomes a universal fallback.
Visible entrants complete continuously and consume caps; contact and firing wait for arrival and normal separation/tell rules.
